name: chatgptaihub-free-skills-marketplace
description: Curated free SMB ChatGPT/Codex-ready SKILL.md packs with editorial trust. Not a scraper index.
audience: SMB — small and mid-size business teams (founder-led to ~200 employees typical)

categories.label: Support
categories.description: Customer triage, reply drafts, escalation hygiene

categories.label: Ops
categories.description: Meetings to actions, weekly briefs, operational checklists

categories.label: Finance
categories.description: Invoice and expense summaries without live credentials

skills.name: Meeting Notes to Actions
skills.description: Turn raw meeting notes into owners, due dates, and a follow-up checklist.

skills.name: Customer Email Triage
skills.description: Classify inbound customer email into priority buckets with draft reply outlines.

skills.name: Weekly Ops Brief
skills.description: Assemble a one-page weekly operations brief from bullet inputs.

skills.name: Outbound Email Draft
skills.description: Draft a single SMB outbound sales email from prospect context with a clear CTA — no auto-send.

skills.name: Checklist from SOP
skills.description: Turn a pasted SOP or runbook into a numbered operator checklist with owners and evidence fields.

skills.name: LinkedIn Post Outline
skills.description: Turn bullet talking points into a LinkedIn post outline with hook, body beats, and CTA — draft only.

skills.name: Proposal Outline (SMB)
skills.description: Build an SMB sales proposal outline with assumptions, scope options, and pricing placeholders — no CRM lock-in.

skills.name: SOP from Bullets
skills.description: Turn tribal-knowledge bullets into a structured SMB SOP draft with purpose, steps, owners, and exceptions.

skills.name: Support Macro Library
skills.description: Build a reusable SMB support macro library from pasted tickets or replies — tone tags, variables, and escalation cues.

skills.name: Content Brief to Draft
skills.description: Expand an SMB content brief into a structured draft with voice placeholders, SEO notes, and human-edit flags — no auto-publish.

skills.name: Pipeline Weekly Rollup
skills.description: Roll pasted SMB pipeline rows into a weekly sales brief — stages, risks, next actions — distinct from ops briefs.

skills.name: Agent Handoff Checklist
skills.description: Produce a deterministic human↔agent or agent↔agent handoff checklist for SMB multi-step work — ownership, artifacts, and stop conditions.

skills.name: Codex PR Summary
skills.description: Summarize a pasted git diff or PR description into an SMB-friendly PR summary with test gaps and reviewer asks — no auto-merge.

skills.name: Bug Repro Steps
skills.description: Force a deterministic bug repro script from messy SMB bug reports before anyone attempts a fix.

schema_notes.skills: Production catalog listings. Each entry must have slug, name, description, category, path, version, status, tags, requires_secrets, env_placeholders; path must resolve to an existing SKILL.md.
schema_notes.example_skills: Removed in v0.1.1 after promoting the three starter stubs into skills[]. New drafts land via PR directly into skills/ + skills[] after editorial review (Notion internal).
schema_notes.promotion: Draft → editorial review (Notion) → PR → skills[] with status published → optional Release tag / Manus feature.
schema_notes.p1: P1 sales/ops/content drafts in v0.2.0: outbound-email-draft, checklist-from-sop, linkedin-post-outline.
schema_notes.content_gen_0_3: v0.3.0-content adds remaining P1 + selected P2 as draft: proposal-outline-smb, sop-from-bullets, support-macro-library, content-brief-to-draft, pipeline-weekly-rollup, agent-handoff-checklist, codex-pr-summary, bug-repro-steps. Skill selection not finalized pending fusion SMB pack if dropped. Audience explicitly SMB.
schema_notes.content_packs: Learning/hub groupings. Each pack references skills[].slug; bodies stay under skills/. Launch packs: ops-engine-starter, support-essentials, sales-accelerator (+ optional content-creation-kit). Pack hubs: packs/<id>/README.md + WALKTHROUGH.md. validate_catalog.py checks pack skill refs when present.
schema_notes.edu_layer: docs/GETTING_STARTED.md, FAQ.md, EXAMPLES_INDEX.md, docs/edu/** added 2026-09-30 edu build; promote messaging for published first; P1 drafts preview-only until status published.
schema_notes.content_gen_0_4: v0.4.0-launch-mass: critical-mass close — promoted outbound-email-draft, proposal-outline-smb, sop-from-bullets, support-macro-library, content-brief-to-draft, pipeline-weekly-rollup, checklist-from-sop to published (≥3 prompts + INSTALL + SMB why). Launch packs README/WALKTHROUGH under packs/. coding-assistant + linkedin-post-outline + agent-handoff remain draft. Template Generator stays SPEC only. No Cap FIRE / Hub WP / LinkedIn send.
